sentences.text:
Applicant :- Netram
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, U.P. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Dr. Surendra Kumar Misra,Avnish Kumar Tiwari Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajai Kumar Srivastava-I,J.
1.
Heard Sri Avnish Kumar Tiwari, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ravi Srivastava, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.

2. The instant application for bail has been moved on behalf of the applicant, Netram with the prayer to enlarge him on bail in F.I.R./Case Crime No.256 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 304B, 323,
504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Mitauli, District Lakhimpur Kheri during pendency of the trial.

3. The prosecution story as culled out from the first information report is that the first informant/father of the deceased got a first information report lodged against the present accused/applicant, Netram, husband of the deceased and co-accused, Smt. Manthra Devi,
sister-in-law of the deceased with the allegation that the deceased was married to the present applicant six years ago.

The accused persons were not satisfied with the articles given by the first Netram vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, ... on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175960573/
1 informant as dowry at the time of marriage.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, the accused persons kept demanding additional dowry and they also used to treat the deceased with cruelty due to non-fulfillment of demand of dowry.
The accused persons demanding a motorcycle, which could not be provided by the first informant/father of the deceased because of his poverty.

On 30.07.2021 at about 22:30 PM,
the first informant came to know that his daughter/deceased was done to death by stabbing by the present applicant.
Thereafter, the first information report came to be lodged against the present applicant and co-accused, Smt. Manthra Devi.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the first information report is based on false and fabricated facts.
The accused/applicant is innocent, who has been falsely implicated in this case because of the fact that he happens to be husband of the deceased.
5. His further submission is that there are general and vague allegations of demand of dowry against the accused/applicant.

He further submits that since there were general allegations against both the accused persons, who were named in the First Information Report, i.e. the present applicant and the co-accused, Smt. Manthra Devi, sister-in-law of the deceased.

However, co-accused, Smt. Manthra Devi has been granted bail by this Court vide order dated 08.02.2022 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.15254 of 2021, therefore, the present applicant also deserves to be enlarged on bail.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.15254 of 2021
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 6. Learned counsel for the applicant has further submitted that the accused/applicant, who is languishing in jail since 31.07.2021, has no previous criminal history.

7. Learned counsel for the applicant has further submitted that in case, the applicant is enlarged on bail, he shall not misuse the liberty of bail and shall also fully cooperate with the trial court in getting the trial concluded expeditiously.
The applicant shall not intimidate or pressurize the witnesses or any other persons acquainted with the facts of the present case.

8. Per contra, learned A.G.A. for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of bail by submitting that the deceased, who was none other than the wife of the present applicant, has been done to death in a brutal manner.
There are allegations of demand of dowry against the accused/applicant also.
He has drawn attention of this Court to the fact that specific role of stabbing the deceased to death was assigned to the present applicant in the first information report.

His further submission is that such allegations are supported by the postmortem report, wherein two ante-mortem injuries were reported on the body of the deceased, which are as under:-
"(i) contusion 10 cm x 6 cm on left side of head just above left ear on dissection underline left temporal parietal bone found fractured, membrane and brain found lacerated and clotted blood present over surface of membrane and brain.
(ii) multiple punctured wound in an area of 30 cm x 15 cm over both side of face,
forehead and head. Largest 3 cm x 1 cm x bone deep smallest 2 cm x 1 cm x muscle deep."
Netram vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, ... on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175960573/
2
9. Learned A.G.A. has also submitted that in case diary no.II, there is a mention of recovery of knife on the pointing out of the applicant.

In the aforesaid facts and circumstances, he submits that the role of the present applicant is distinguishable from that of co-accused, Smt. Manthra Devi,
sister-in-law of the deceased, to whom, no specific role of stabbing the deceased was assigned in the first information report.

10. Having heard the learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and upon perusal of record, it transpires that in the first information report, role of stabbing the deceased was assigned to the present applicant, who is the husband of the deceased.
The postmortem report of the deceased prima facie corroborates the prosecution story.
There are multiple punctured wounds of 30 cm x 15 cm over both side of face, forehead and head.
There is also recovery of a knife on the pointing out of the applicant.

11. Thus, keeping in view the aforesaid overall facts and circumstances of this case, nature of offence and evidence regarding the complicity of applicant, but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, no case for bail, at this stage, is made out.
12. Accordingly, the instant applicant for bail is rejected.

13. It is made clear that the trial of the aforesaid case shall be conducted without being influenced by any observation made herein above which are confined to the disposal of the instant bail application.
